evidence: app/src/lib/server/pokeapi.ts:110-113 — card() builds the sprite URL for every card list rendered via cardsFor (:117-130), covering move/ability/type lists in one fix
app/src/lib/server/pokeapi.ts:184 — homeList builds the same sprite URL a second time, so a Deoxys-style sprite fix must land twice

app/src/components/MoveTable.tsx:37-46 — sort behaviour (missing-values-last, direction flip) lives in one component used by every move table
changeability.rationale: Data bug fixes almost always land in the single server module, and display logic is centralized in format.ts and the shared components; the one notable exception is the duplicated sprite-URL construction, which is precisely the bug class the scenario names.

evidence: app/src/lib/queries.ts:4-53 — every route reaches the API only through narrow query wrappers with 'use server' bodies, matching the documented SolidStart pattern
app/src/lib/server/pokeapi.ts:23,30-56 — process.env, fetch, caching and URL construction are confined to the server module; nothing client-side knows about the API
app/src/lib/types.ts:1-70 — typed DTOs (Card, Named, *Detail) are the only contract crossing the server/client boundary
app/src/components/PokemonCards.tsx:14-33 — presentational, props-only; no fetching, no params, no globals
app/src/routes/types/index.tsx:14-27 — routes consume only query results, never internals
coupling.rationale: Textbook separation: server-only data access behind a query seam, props-driven components, explicit DTO types, and environment/URL knowledge in exactly one file. I'd point to lib/queries.ts + lib/server/pokeapi.ts as the pattern for new sections.

evidence: app/src/lib/server/pokeapi.ts:117-130 — cardsFor's extra callback handles the ability page's 'hidden' variant without boolean flags; used by moves (:335), abilities (:348) and types (:377)
app/src/components/MoveTable.tsx:12-18,37-46 — COLUMNS model + generic sorter stretches to any table shape; the showLevel prop (:23) is the only flag and is justified
app/src/components/Section.tsx:7-13 — one-landmark abstraction reused by every page section
app/src/routes/abilities/[name].tsx:13-26 — the Switch/Match null-vs-found page skeleton is repeated verbatim in four route files, so an Items section copies it
app/src/lib/server/pokeapi.ts:113 vs :184 — sprite URL built twice instead of one shared helper
abstraction_design.rationale: The components and data helpers are built around the app's real variation and stretch well; the cost is thin but repeated per-route boilerplate and two or three small duplicated expressions rather than flag-parameter creep.

findings.issue: The card sprite URL is constructed twice: card() (:113) for cardsFor-based lists and again inline in homeList (:184), so a sprite-scheme bug fix must be applied in two places.
findings.suggestion: Extract a spriteUrl(id) helper and use it from both card() and homeList (ideally have homeList build its items through card()).

findings.issue: Search-param array handling is duplicated: first() in routes/index.tsx:8 vs an inline Array.isArray ternary here for params.game.
findings.suggestion: Move first() into a shared module (e.g. lib/format.ts or a new lib/params.ts) and use it in both routes.

findings.issue: The type-color style rule (background-color: var(--type-<name>)) is re-implemented inline here while a helper already exists in components/TypeBadge.tsx:4-6.
findings.suggestion: Export the style helper from TypeBadge (or a lib module) and reuse it for the type tiles.

findings.issue: The Switch/Match(null → NotFound) page skeleton is copied verbatim across four route files, so each new resource page repeats ~10 lines of boilerplate.
findings.suggestion: Either accept it as the idiomatic SolidStart pattern, or add a tiny <ResourcePage data={...}>{(d) => …}</ResourcePage> wrapper to centralize null-handling and the title.

findings.issue: showLevel is a boolean prop, a mild flag-parameter smell in an otherwise model-driven table.
findings.suggestion: Acceptable as-is; if the table grows more per-method variation, derive column visibility from the rows or a column-model prop instead.

findings.issue: PAGE_SIZE is exported but only used inside this module; the route layer re-derives pagination state independently (pageHref in routes/index.tsx:66).
findings.suggestion: Either drop the export or have the route consume it so page size changes have one authority.

summary: A clean, idiomatic SolidStart app: server data access confined to one module behind documented query/'use server' seams, presentational props-only components, and typed DTOs that make the server/client contract explicit. Change-data-source and most bug fixes are one-file affairs; the main editability cost is the repeated per-route page skeleton and a few small duplicated expressions, most notably the sprite-URL construction the bug scenario targets. I'd merge this with a note to extract a shared spriteUrl helper.
